verdict.rationale: Vanta is an automation-heavy compliance platform with automated tests, custom tests, workflows, and agentic features, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence documents version history, review/approval of changes to automations, or rollback of tests or workflows. The Claude Code plugin's draft pull request applies to the user's own infrastructure-as-code remediation, not to versioning Vanta automations, so it earns no credit here.
